+# ===========================================================================
+# SELF-HOSTING — `Prim.*` -> `__prim_*` normalization, written in Rian
+# ===========================================================================
+# Goal (ADR-0047 §2, the reserved `Prim` intrinsic namespace): the Rian-written
+# counterpart of `Rian.Prim.normalize` — rewrite every surface `Prim.<name>(args)`
+# call into the canonical intrinsic `__prim_<name>(args)`, recursing through the
+# whole expression tree. Fixpoint-locked against `Rian.Prim.normalize` in
+# `test/rian/prim_fixpoint_test.exs`.
+#
+# Operates on the same `Rian.Pratt` surface AST as `core.rian` (the type below
+# mirrors it). Patterns carry no `Prim.*` calls, so the walk passes them through
+# unchanged (it only recurses into expression positions).
+#
+# Difference from the oracle (documented tail): `Rian.Prim.normalize` RAISES on an
+# unknown `Prim.<name>` (reserved namespace). This port has no host raise, so it
+# leaves an unknown `Prim.x` in place (still normalizing its args) — conservative,
+# never a miscompile. The compiler's own sources only use valid prims.
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+mod PrimNorm do
+  # ── surface expression AST (mirrors Rian.Pratt tuples / core.rian's Surface) ──
+  type Surface := SNum(String)
+                | SStr(String)
+                | SChar(Int53)
+                | SId(String)
+                | SAtom(String)
+                | SUnary(String, Surface)
+                | SBin(String, Surface, Surface)
+                | SCall(Surface, Vec(Surface))
+                | SLabel(String, Surface)
+                | SDot(Surface, String)
+                | SIf(Surface, Surface, Surface)
+                | STuple(Vec(Surface))
+                | SList(Vec(Surface), STail)
+                | SMap(Vec(SPair))
+                | SBlock(Vec(SStmt))
+                | SCase(Surface, Vec(SArm))
+                | SLambda(Vec(SParam), Surface)
+                | SCapArg(Int53)
+                | SCapture(Surface)
+                | SCaptureNamed(Surface, Int53)
+                | SWith(Vec(SClause), Surface, Vec(SArm))
+
+  type STail := TClose | TTail(Surface)
+  type SPair := SP(String, Surface)
+  type SStmt := SBind(String, Surface) | STypedBind(String, String, Surface) | SExpr(Surface)
+  type SGuard := GNone | GSome(Surface)
+  type SArm := SArm(SPat, SGuard, Surface)
+  type SClause := SClause(SPat, Surface)
+  type SParamTy := PtNone | PtSome(String)
+  type SParam := SParam(String, SParamTy)
+
+  # patterns are carried verbatim (no `Prim.*` calls live in a pattern position).
+  type SPat := PWild
+             | PVar(String)
+             | PLitInt(Int53)
+             | PLitStr(String)
+             | PPChar(Int53)
+             | PPAtom(String)
+             | PPTuple(Vec(SPat))
+             | PCtor(String, Vec(SPat))
+             | PPList(Vec(SPat), PTail)
+             | PPStruct(String, Vec(PPair))
+             | PPMap(Vec(PPair))
+
+  type PTail := PtlClose | PtlTail(SPat)
+  type PPair := PPr(String, SPat)
+
+  # ── the normalization walk ──
+  # The `Prim.<name>(args)` rewrite clause MUST precede the general call clause.
+  pub def normalize(Surface) Surface
+  pub def normalize(SNum(t)) := SNum(t)
+  pub def normalize(SStr(s)) := SStr(s)
+  pub def normalize(SChar(c)) := SChar(c)
+  pub def normalize(SId(n)) := SId(n)
+  pub def normalize(SAtom(a)) := SAtom(a)
+  pub def normalize(SUnary(op, x)) := SUnary(op, normalize(x))
+  pub def normalize(SBin(op, l, r)) := SBin(op, normalize(l), normalize(r))
+  pub def normalize(SCall(SDot(SId("Prim"), name), args)) := norm_prim_call(name, args)
+  pub def normalize(SCall(f, args)) := SCall(normalize(f), normalize_list(args))
+  pub def normalize(SLabel(n, e)) := SLabel(n, normalize(e))
+  pub def normalize(SDot(h, n)) := SDot(normalize(h), n)
+  pub def normalize(SIf(c, t, e)) := SIf(normalize(c), normalize(t), normalize(e))
+  pub def normalize(STuple(es)) := STuple(normalize_list(es))
+  pub def normalize(SList(es, tl)) := SList(normalize_list(es), normalize_tail(tl))
+  pub def normalize(SMap(ps)) := SMap(normalize_pairs(ps))
+  pub def normalize(SBlock(ss)) := SBlock(normalize_stmts(ss))
+  pub def normalize(SCase(s, arms)) := SCase(normalize(s), normalize_arms(arms))
+  pub def normalize(SLambda(ps, b)) := SLambda(ps, normalize(b))
+  pub def normalize(SCapArg(n)) := SCapArg(n)
+  pub def normalize(SCapture(b)) := SCapture(normalize(b))
+  pub def normalize(SCaptureNamed(p, a)) := SCaptureNamed(normalize(p), a)
+  pub def normalize(SWith(cs, b, els)) := SWith(normalize_clauses(cs), normalize(b), normalize_arms(els))
+
+  # a `Prim.<name>(args)`: a KNOWN prim becomes `__prim_<name>(args)`; an unknown one
+  # is left in place (the oracle raises — a documented tail). Args normalize either way.
+  def norm_prim_call(name String, args Vec(Surface)) Surface
+  def norm_prim_call(name, args)
+    if prim_name(name) do
+      SCall(SId("__prim_" <> name), normalize_list(args))
+    else
+      SCall(SDot(SId("Prim"), name), normalize_list(args))
+    end
+  end
+
+  def normalize_list(Vec(Surface)) Vec(Surface)
+  def normalize_list([]) := []
+  def normalize_list([x | rest]) := [normalize(x) | normalize_list(rest)]
+
+  def normalize_tail(STail) STail
+  def normalize_tail(TClose) := TClose
+  def normalize_tail(TTail(e)) := TTail(normalize(e))
+
+  def normalize_pairs(Vec(SPair)) Vec(SPair)
+  def normalize_pairs([]) := []
+  def normalize_pairs([SP(k, v) | rest]) := [SP(k, normalize(v)) | normalize_pairs(rest)]
+
+  def normalize_stmts(Vec(SStmt)) Vec(SStmt)
+  def normalize_stmts([]) := []
+  def normalize_stmts([SBind(n, e) | rest]) := [SBind(n, normalize(e)) | normalize_stmts(rest)]
+  def normalize_stmts([STypedBind(n, t, e) | rest]) := [STypedBind(n, t, normalize(e)) | normalize_stmts(rest)]
+  def normalize_stmts([SExpr(e) | rest]) := [SExpr(normalize(e)) | normalize_stmts(rest)]
+
+  def normalize_arms(Vec(SArm)) Vec(SArm)
+  def normalize_arms([]) := []
+  def normalize_arms([SArm(p, g, b) | rest]) := [SArm(p, normalize_guard(g), normalize(b)) | normalize_arms(rest)]
+
+  def normalize_guard(SGuard) SGuard
+  def normalize_guard(GNone) := GNone
+  def normalize_guard(GSome(e)) := GSome(normalize(e))
+
+  def normalize_clauses(Vec(SClause)) Vec(SClause)
+  def normalize_clauses([]) := []
+  def normalize_clauses([SClause(p, e) | rest]) := [SClause(p, normalize(e)) | normalize_clauses(rest)]
+
+  # the closed set of reserved prims (ADR-0047 §2), mirroring Rian.Prim.@prims.
+  def prim_name(String) Bool
+  def prim_name("str_chars") := true
+  def prim_name("str_from_chars") := true
+  def prim_name("str_concat") := true
+  def prim_name("str_concat_all") := true
+  def prim_name("str_to_atom") := true
+  def prim_name("str_to_float") := true
+  def prim_name("char_code") := true
+  def prim_name("int_to_string") := true
+  def prim_name("int_to_float") := true
+  def prim_name("char_to_string") := true
+  def prim_name("map_new") := true
+  def prim_name("map_get") := true
+  def prim_name("map_put") := true
+  def prim_name("map_has") := true
+  def prim_name("wrapping_add") := true
+  def prim_name("saturating_add") := true
+  def prim_name("checked_add") := true
+  def prim_name(_) := false
+end

 # ADR-0047 — Portable Prelude & Stdlib: three tiers, hybrid implementation, `Option` not `nil`
 
 **Status:** Accepted (direction) · the *contents* fill incrementally; this ADR fixes the *model*
-**Implemented:** partial — primitive layer (`Rian.Prim`, `test/rian/prim_test.exs`) + portable prelude written in Rian (`examples/rian/prelude_{int,str,dict}.rian`); contents fill incrementally
+**Implemented:** partial — primitive layer (`Rian.Prim`, `test/rian/prim_test.exs`) + portable prelude written in Rian (`examples/rian/prelude_{int,str,dict}.rian`); contents fill incrementally. The `Prim.* → __prim_*` normalization (§2) is itself **self-hosted** — `compiler/prim.rian` (`PrimNorm.normalize`) reproduces `Rian.Prim.normalize`, fixpoint-locked in `test/rian/prim_fixpoint_test.exs` (ADR-0063 #2)
 **Refs:** ADR-0027 (free BEAM FFI; self-hosting), ADR-0029 (dot qualifier), ADR-0034 (nominal sums; `Option`), ADR-0035 (no hidden control flow), ADR-0040 (`Result`), ADR-0041 (target model — "Rian prelude provided on every target"; module resolution), ADR-0042 (protocols), ADR-0046 (compile-time by default)
 **Owners:** Chloe Bennett (prelude) · Arthur Pendelton (stdlib-in-Rian) · Elena Rostova (primitives/perf) · Maya Lin (tiers/multi-target) · Kira Neri (determinism) · Samir Patel (conformance) · Marcus Chen (effect boundary) · Liam Davis (namespacing) · Rachel Okafor (PM)
